translations.source_quote: まずは生で、皮ごとかじってみてください
translations.text: First, try it raw, biting into it skin and all.

translations.source_quote: ぽりぽりしていて、香りがいいです

untranslated.gloss_ja: ≈ 軽く歯ごたえのある音

translations.source_quote: 火を通すなら、弱火でゆっくり
translations.text: To cook it, slowly, over a low flame.

translations.source_quote: オリーブオイルと塩だけで焼くと、とろりとして、甘みが一番よく出ます
translations.text: Roasted with only olive oil and salt, it turns soft and tender, and the sweetness comes out best.

translations.source_quote: 葉も捨てないで、刻んでかき揚げにするとおいしいですよ
translations.text: Don't throw away the leaves, either; chopped and fried as kakiage, they're delicious.

translations.source_quote: 農薬を使わずに育てています
雪下で踏ん張った分、大きくて甘いにんじんになりました
translations.text: For holding on under the snow, they became big, sweet carrots.

translations.source_quote: 遠くの国で、このにんじんを食べてくれている人がいると思うと、それだけで畑に出る力になります
translations.text: When I think that someone in a faraway country is eating this carrot, that alone gives me the strength to go out to the field.
translations.title_text: For the one who eats it

translations.source_quote: ひと口かじったときに、この山の雪の冷たさを、少しでも感じてもらえたらうれしいです
translations.text: When you take a bite, I would be glad if you could feel, even a little, the cold of the snow on these mountains.
translations.title_text: To the one who receives this letter

translations.source_quote: ここは山あいで、冬は一メートル近く雪が積もります
translations.text: This is mountain country; in winter the snow piles up close to a meter deep.

translations.source_quote: にんじんは秋に育てて、雪の下にそのまま置いておきます
translations.source_reason_quote: 雪の下は零度くらいで凍らず、にんじんが身を守ろうとして甘みをためるからです
translations.text: The carrots grow through autumn, and then I leave them right where they are, under the snow.
translations.reason_text: Under the snow it stays around zero degrees without freezing, and the carrot stores up sweetness to protect itself.

translations.source_quote: 肥料は堆肥だけで、化学肥料は使いません
translations.text: The only fertilizer is compost; I don't use chemical fertilizer.

translations.source_quote: 種は指二本ぶん、間を空けて落とします
translations.text: I drop the seeds two fingers apart.

translations.source_quote: 雪が降ってから、ひと月は待ちます
translations.source_reason_quote: 早く掘ると、まだ甘みがのっていないからです
translations.text: After the snow falls, I wait a month.
translations.reason_text: Dig too early, and the sweetness hasn't come in yet.

translations.source_quote: 葉の先が丸まってきたら、水やりを止めます
translations.text: When the leaf tips start to curl, I stop watering.

translations.source_quote: 畑は親から引き継いで二十年になります
translations.text: I took over the field from my parents; it has been twenty years now.
